jordan: Heads-up — FinCo POC kickoff. They want SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning for ~10k users, group->RBAC mapping, domain proofing for multiple subdomains (*.finco.com), EU data residency, and 8h session timeout. Also asking about session affinity/sticky routing, SCIM throttling/backoff behavior, audit log exports, and a hosted vs dedicated cost comparison. Security questionnaire inbound. Can eng + security weigh in? :eyes:

sam: Thanks. A few quick clarifying q's: 1) do they need SCIM full bulk import or incremental delta sync only? 2) expected provisioning RPS during sync? 3) Are groups authoritative in IdP or in our system?

jordan: Client says IdP is authoritative for groups. They want full provisioning initially (one-time), then incremental group+user updates. They mentioned custom attrs: employeeId, costCenter, roleLevel.

priya: We support group->RBAC mapping. Notes: hosted default SCIM throttle is 60 req/min/org; Dedicated can raise throttles and run parallel workers. For a 10k initial sync recommend either CSV bulk import or our scim-bulk-import tool to avoid hitting live rate limits. Example quick config we can give them: ```json
{
  "scim": {"rate_limit_per_min": 100, "backoff_seconds": 5, "parallel_workers": 4}
}
```

sam: Is that config tenant-scoped? And how does session affinity behave on hosted vs dedicated?

priya: Yes tenant-scoped for Dedicated; hosted has per-org caps but we can request exceptions for enterprise customers. Session affinity: Dedicated = cookie-based sticky LB (configurable TTL). Hosted = smart routing by token with transient pinning; long sessions (8h) need KV cache TTL adjustments and have slightly higher memory/kv cost. Also note: group propagation end-to-end depends on provisioning latency and our membership cache — worst case group membership visible in app could be ~30–60s for backfills unless we trigger immediate re-eval.

marc: Security checklist items: they want BYOK KMS + HSM, SAML cert rotation policy documented, mTLS for SCIM endpoints, and audit log streaming to their SIEM (syslog/S3). We can provide SOC2 artifact and pen-test summary; for exports we support S3+Kinesis streams. Also confirm retention windows (they asked 1 year): hosted default is 90 days but enterprise can request longer retention (legal/paid add-on).

sam: Pricing angle — jordan, can you ask for expected daily active tokens and peak RPS? I can model hosted vs dedicated (dedicated has monthly commit + lower per-token run cost but infra commit). Also include costs for longer log retention and BYOK.

jordan: Will do. They also requested SLA for provisioning latency <=30s. Is that realistic?

priya: 30s is tight on hosted for full membership propagation. With async flows+cache priming we can usually show the user in ~5–10s for create/login flows, but full group sync propagation may hit 30–60s depending on load. For Dedicated with reserved workers and priority queues we can meet 30s consistently. I'll add recommended deployment knobs in the runbook.

tilly-bot: deploy-bot: scim-bulk-import-tool v1.3 deployed to staging. Docs: https://go.redwood/scim-import. :robot_face:

jordan: Great — I'll collect RPS + token estimates and the security questionnaire, then send a consolidated answer + a rough hosted vs dedicated cost sketch by EOD. Ping me if you want me to include any sample configs or runbook snippets. :thumbsup:
